work_experience:
Nov 2023 - Present
Top AI + GameFi Project (Undisclosed) Singapore
Marketing & Community Operations:
Led full-stack user operations across Discord, Telegram, and Twitter. Grew Discord to over 100,000 users and established a comprehensive role-based reward system (Discord Roles). Managed Twitter content strategy; grew followers to over 300,000. Single tweets reached over 2 million impressions with an average engagement rate of 9%.
NFT/TGE Promotion & Sales:
Led two NFT sales and two large-scale airdrops. Engaged over 300 top-tier communities and KOLs. Twice ranked #1 on Opensea’s 24h trending list. Airdrops attracted over 10 million unique active wallets (UAW). Oversaw the entire TGE on Binance Alpha and listing process, including documentation submission and post-TGE airdrop distribution. AI Game Operations:
Developed market positioning narratives for the AI game and promoted brand awareness among KOLs and major players. Led closed beta recruitment with over 100 KOLs and gaming guilds, achieving high market penetration in Asia, with 1,000+ Korean users onboarded.

Mar 2024 - Aug 2024
Meme Project on BSC (Peak Market Cap: $90) Singapore
Designed and executed airdrop strategy, covering user targeting, task conversion, and reward mechanisms. Reached over 300,000 users. Directed community event planning on Discord; grew the community to over 100,000 members with highly engaging discussions. Managed PR and media relations. Created promotional materials (posters, tweets, media copy) to increase brand exposure. Independently handled centralized exchange (CEX) listing procedures: document preparation, due diligence, and business communication.

Marketing Operations, Gaming Operations Department MetaApp (Project Twelve) Singapore
Community Growth & Campaigns: Served as core moderator; grew Discord from 0 to 50,000 and Twitter by over 60,000. Led a genesis airdrop in partnership with Steam; campaign attracted 1M+ SBT badge holders. Authored 3 marketing proposals and organized 5 campaigns; single Twitter posts achieved 10,000+ engagements. Developer Outreach & Content: Engaged with 500+ indie game developers; published 3 in-depth collaboration articles in English. Produced 8 tutorial videos for the in-house game editor, including scripting, subtitling, and voice recording.

work_experience_zh:
2023年11月 - 现在
顶级人工智能 + 游戏金融项目（未披露）新加坡
市场与社区运营：
在 Discord、Telegram 和 Twitter 上领导全栈用户运营。
将Discord用户增长到超过100,000人，并建立了一个全面的基于角色的奖励系统（Discord角色）。
管理了Twitter内容策略；将粉丝数量增加到超过300,000。
单条推文的印象超过200万，平均参与率为9%。
NFT/TGE推广与销售：
领导了两次NFT销售和两次大规模空投。
与300多个顶级社区和KOL合作。
两次在Opensea的24小时趋势榜上排名第一。
空投吸引了超过1000万个独特活跃钱包（UAW）。
监督了在Binance Alpha上的整个TGE和上市过程，包括文档提交和TGE后的空投分发。
人工智能游戏运营：
为人工智能游戏开发了市场定位叙述，并在KOL和主要参与者中提升了品牌知名度。
领导了与超过100名KOL和游戏公会的封闭测试招募，在亚洲实现了高市场渗透，成功吸引了1000多名韩国用户。

Mar 2024 - Aug 2024
BSC上的Meme项目（峰值市值：$90）新加坡
设计并执行了空投策略，包括用户定位、任务转化和奖励机制。
超过300,000用户。
在Discord上指导社区活动策划；将社区发展到超过100,000名成员，进行高度互动的讨论。
管理公关和媒体关系。
创建了宣传材料（海报、推文、媒体文案）以增加品牌曝光。
独立处理中心化交易所（CEX）上市程序：文件准备、尽职调查和业务沟通。

市场运营，游戏运营部门 MetaApp（项目十二）新加坡
社区增长与活动：担任核心管理员；将Discord从0增长到50,000，Twitter增长超过60,000。
与Steam合作领导了一次创世空投；活动吸引了超过100万名SBT徽章持有者。
撰写了3份营销提案并组织了5个活动；单条Twitter帖子获得了超过10,000次互动。
开发者外联与内容：与500多位独立游戏开发者互动；用英语发布了3篇深入的合作文章。
为内部游戏编辑器制作了8个教程视频，包括脚本编写、字幕和录音。
